interface.title: Anchorgating (FACS gating · runs only in the browser · v0.9.4)
interface.field: Flow cytometry / cell biology (apoptosis and cell-cycle assays)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and figure preparation: gating raw cytometry events, comparing treatment groups across replicates, exporting figures and tables
interface.what_it_is_for: Gate flow cytometry samples in the browser, draw the gates once on a control 'anchor' sample so that every replicate and condition in the group follows them, and turn the resulting population percentages into publication bar plots, histograms and CSVs.

data.note: The interface is in Korean. Built-in simulated demo data loads on start: an apoptosis set (Cell A and Cell B × Unstained, Annexin V only, 7-AAD only, Control, Drug A, Drug B, Drug A+B × Rep 1–3, 10,000 events each). Choosing the Cell cycle protocol swaps in a PI DNA-content set (Control, Drug A, Drug B, Drug A+B × 3 reps), and choosing Custom loads the same apoptosis set with no gates. In the apoptosis demo, Control and Drug A+B have identical values in all three replicates, so their SD is 0.00 (screens/003.webp). Switching protocol reloads the demo and throws away earlier gate edits: the widened P2 was back to 90.5% after switching (screens/033.webp). No test files were available, so no FCS file was uploaded.

tree.specific: Gate apoptosis (Annexin V/7-AAD) and cell-cycle (PI) demo samples with anchor gating across Rep 1–3 and the Cell A and Cell B groups, then export Prism-style bar plots, histograms, CSVs and gate templates

features.name: Anchor gating with per-sample overrides
features.general: Mark one item as the reference; edits to its regions are copied to every linked item in the group. Editing a follower creates a marked exception that can be reverted, and a link toggle detaches or reattaches an item.
features.specific: Anchor icon on Control; 연동 (linked) samples follow its gate tree. Dragging a gate on a follower creates a '개별' (individual) override with 앵커로 되돌리기 / 모두 되돌리기 (revert to anchor / revert all). The link icon switches a sample to 독립 (independent) and back. In the demo the anchor applied within one replicate: moving the Rep 1 Control quadrant changed only the Rep 1 values (screens/039.webp).
steps: pick the anchor sample (anchor icon or ⋯ → 앵커로 고정 / set as anchor)
drag a gate on the anchor; the linked samples update
drag a gate on a follower → orange '개별' override and badge
press 모두 되돌리기 or 앵커로 되돌리기 to restore
toggle the link icon to make a sample independent and relink it
serves_tasks: Propagate the representative sample's gates to all samples in its group and check them side by side
Override the shared gate on one sample, then restore it
Detach a sample so it keeps its own gates, then reattach it

features.specific: 샘플 비교 (sample comparison) view: choose the group and plot (e.g. P3 · PE-A × 7-AAD-A) and the S/M/L size. Each card shows quadrant %, an anchor or 연동 (linked) tag, and handles you can drag.

drag a gate in any card (it becomes an override, or moves the whole group if the card is the anchor)
